items.t: A plant that is not doing well and is being blamed on someone.
A single sock on a radiator, ownership disputed.
A stack of post nobody has opened, the top one clearly important.
A calendar with one thing written on it, underlined three times.
A door with a sign on it that was funny once.
A drying rack holding exactly one item.
Reading glasses on top of somebody's head, currently being searched for.
A charging cable that reaches the sofa if you sit at an angle.
A jar of something nobody will finish and nobody will throw away.
A takeaway menu used as a coaster since forever.
A tin of biscuits containing sewing supplies.
A remote shaped gap on the sofa arm where something used to live.
Shoes by the door in a pile that has a system only one person understands.
A blanket on the back of the sofa that {4} regards as structurally load bearing.
One good pen everyone knows not to take.
A whiteboard with nothing on it but a drawing of {4}.
